title: Skip unchanged computed Combobox size updates
answers: Why does the Combobox rerender for identical size measurements?
How do I prevent unchanged menu dimensions from updating the input DOM?
How should useComboboxFloat deduplicate size callbacks?
body:
Symptom: Repeated identical menu size measurements rerender the Combobox and update its input DOM despite unchanged visible attributes.
Root cause: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Combobox/useComboboxFloat.ts:useComboboxFloat called setPopoverMaxSize with a new size object for every measurement.
Fix pattern: Compare computed width and height with a ref holding the last committed dimensions; return when both match, otherwise update the ref before setting state.
Constraints: Compare the final dimensions after sizing calculations, not just raw available space; skip state updates only when both dimensions are unchanged.
applies: Popover maximum-size state updates in the useComboboxFloat size middleware.
